commandScope: Read-only source and dependency precheck; no game, browser or binder was started.
cause: The precheck incorrectly required every package dependency to be listed in the frozen browser/runtime snapshot. package-lock.json is explicitly a dependency receipt but is outside that snapshot; binder already verifies its current bytes independently.
resolution: Preserve this failure; check every dependency against current bytes, and additionally against the frozen source hash whenever listed. Explicitly report outside-snapshot lockfile scope instead of claiming it was frozen in1370 files.
